// divguard:path coding/session.go

package coding

import "fmt"

type Session struct {
	listeners []func(int)
	onError   func(error)
}

// dispatch recovers each listener on its own and reports the panic.
func (s *Session) dispatch(ev int) {
	for _, l := range s.listeners {
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if r := recover(); r != nil {
					s.onError(fmt.Errorf("listener panicked: %v", r))
				}
			}()
			l(ev)
		}()
	}
}

// run rethrows after cleanup.
func run(fn func()) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			panic(r)
		}
	}()
	fn()
}
